dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep posterior inclination, measured at approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle visible where the steep melon slope meets the horizontal plane of the rostrum.
